correctness.rationale: The exact Laplacian invariant decomposition produces explicit three-case entries. Sufficiency follows from 0<=F<=1 and monotonicity of (1-F(x))/x, while necessity follows from K2 between-part entries, large-star diagonal limits under boundedness, and dense rational part-size ratios. All quantifiers and h=0 boundary are covered. For [2/2] Gauss Padé, numerator=(x-3)^2+3>0 and g(x)=12/(x^2+6x+12) strictly decreases. Exact-rational script checks 45 cases (1630 entries) and the negative P4 h=20 fraction, independently of the analytic proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed claim is an if-and-only-if scalar shape criterion quantified simultaneously over all unweighted connected complete multipartite graphs and all positive timesteps, with a fourth-order Padé exception to unrestricted monotonicity barriers. Readable prior material treats universal radius of absolute monotonicity (not this restricted-family equivalence), earlier generic numerical positivity results, or a directed Markov counterexample. The proof is not a parameter substitution into those prior theorems; its necessity quantifies over varying part sizes to recover pointwise scalar inequalities.

value.rationale: A single checkable scalar shape criterion classifies unconditional Markov positivity of arbitrary bounded rational heat filters on every complete multipartite graph, avoiding all-size entrywise matrix checks. The fourth-order Gauss–Legendre step is unconditionally strictly positive on this infinite network class despite its zero unrestricted absolute-monotonicity radius and an explicit four-vertex path failure. This identifies a sharp topology-sensitive preservation mechanism, not a numerical threshold increment.
